headline: Training Camps Open
text: We made it! By the end of the week, camps will be up and operational and all NFC North teams will be playing (or practicing anyway).

camps.location: Halas Hall in Lake Forest, Illinois
camps.text: Defending NFC North Champs, the Bears have the division's toughest schedule.
The Lions placed three players on the physically unable to perform (PUP) list ahead of training camp: Brian Branch, Kerby Joseph, and Tyler Conklin.

camps.location: Ray Nitschke Field in Green Bay, Wisconsin
camps.text: This is Green Bay's 81st training camp, dating back to 1946 with Curly Lambeau.

camps.location: TCO Performance Center in Eagan, Minnesota
camps.text: All eyes will be on the quarterback competition between Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy.

headline: Offseason Grades Are In
text: The offseason grades are in and none of the NFC North teams did particularly well according to CBS Sports and PFT. C's across the board with the Packers getting a C- from CBS.
